title: Session-owned retained event evidence hydration query v1

session.description: Exact retained session. The fixed server principal must own it and its query/hydration/privacy grants must remain live.

generation.description: Exact nonzero session symbol-table generation as a canonical u64 decimal string.

revision_digest.description: Exact current event revision digest returned by query or explain; never a source-media digest.

anchor.description: Required full current authority/effect-history token; a changed head requires explicit session rebase.

level.description: H0 discovers exact identity, availability and prices; H1 delivers a semantic synopsis of retained metadata. No H2/H3/H4 or media disclosure.

descriptor_digest.description: Exact H0 descriptor digest, required for H1 and progressive continuation.

budget_tokens.description: Per-request token ceiling. Native conservative quotes are H0=5000 and H1=16000; the session lifetime budget must also suffice. Charge is durable before disclosure.

continuation.description: The complete exact receipt.continuation JSON object encoded as a string, including privacyEpoch in both anchors. H1 only. Native durable issuance/consumption verification refuses replay; a bare cursor token is insufficient.
